title: Runtime exposes version lineage and fails closed on incompatible rules changes
preconditions: World is pinned to an explicit runtime manifest
A synthetic incompatible world_rules_version is available for negative testing

steps.notes: Runtime exposes all required version fields
Existing world cannot silently adopt new semantics
Explicit migration path is required for incompatible changes

assertions: Runtime exposes product_version, spec_version, world_rules_version, agent_protocol_version, event_catalog_version, world_id, world_version, world_seed_digest, configuration_digest, current_cycle, ledger_head, snapshot_head
Existing world cannot silently adopt new semantics
Explicit migration path or new world_version is required
Code deployment MUST NOT silently change the meaning of an existing world
Incomplete runtime manifest (missing ledger_head) is rejected by schema
